pairs.evidence: app/_lib/db/core.ts:3183 Org-member and benchmark seeds commit rows individually before recording completion, so interruption can leave partial data that the next boot adopts as finished.

techniques.evidence: app/_lib/db/core.ts:3414 These seeds populate ordinary candidate records, not host-acting or always-on configuration devices; the refresh predicate preserves application edits.

app/_lib/db/seed-benchmark-team.ts:69 The loop inserts without a surrounding transaction or preceding failure marker; completion is marked afterward at line 83, while lines 47–48 adopt any surviving rows as complete on restart.

app/_lib/db/core.ts:317 Connection acquisition has no enclosing failure cleanup: later DDL, migration, or tenancy-check exceptions escape without explicitly closing the handle, before it reaches the singleton.
app/_lib/db/core.ts:310 This initializer reuses its process connection, including across development module reloads; it implements no operator-triggered configuration reload.
app/_lib/db/core.ts:3341 The input is a typed demo-data corpus inserted into SQLite, rather than an operator-authored declarative bootstrap or workflow request schema.
app/_lib/db-path.ts:152 The boot helper opens SQLite directly through the built-in database driver; this path has no pluggable sealing provider or storage-backed unsealer catalog.
